MAKE A VIDEO →

What the generator makes

Enter a topic such as “Pakistan” or a short phrase such as “climate action.” MATCH CUT searches for public article text, checks candidate page images with OCR, and uses the matching phrase as the focal point of a short editorial sequence.

The finished file is a 9:16 MP4 for vertical viewing. A yellow marker stroke sits behind the printed phrase, and each cut replaces the article fragment with another match. Public source links and generated-page labels appear with the result so you can see where each excerpt came from.

01 · ENTERType one word or a phrase of up to four words.
02 · CHOOSESet the page count, video length, format, and sound.
03 · DOWNLOADSelect Generate Match Cut, preview the result, and save the MP4.

Designed for a simple first try

You do not need to upload newspaper images or place the highlight by hand. Source search, word matching, page selection, and video rendering happen when you select Generate Match Cut. If public matches are limited, the sequence can include clearly identified fictional editorial pages.

Choose more pages for quicker cuts within the same video length. Every selected page is included once. Try a distinctive word first: a short, unambiguous phrase gives the page reader a better chance of finding usable matches across several articles.
